sources.title: Agentic HPC Pipeline Initiative
sources.evidence_excerpt: AHPI proposes AI agents that select DOE simulation tools, configure/validate inputs, run cloud simulations, produce recommendations and digital twins.

sources.title: AI Agents for Enabling Autonomous Experiments at ORNL's HPC and Manufacturing User Facilities
sources.evidence_excerpt: Modular cross-facility architecture: LLM natural-language interface, multi-agent decision making, facility APIs, provenance-aware infrastructure; demonstrated on additive-manufacturing workflow linking experiment and HPC.

sources.title: ChatHPC publications
sources.evidence_excerpt: ChatHPC uses small specialist assistants for HPC stack tasks; the public abstract reports Code Llama fine-tuning, one node/two H100s, and targets portability, parallelization, optimization, scalability and instrumentation.

sources.title: Autonomous workflow for single-crystal neutron diffraction
sources.evidence_excerpt: Autonomous neutron workflow uses real-time image segmentation, distributed training on Summit, and a web frontend; intended to steer the next experiment at HFIR with less expert intervention.

sources.title: Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science
sources.evidence_excerpt: DOE source for OLCF and Frontier as the first exascale supercomputer, greater than 1 exaflop Linpack in 2022.

sources.title: Data Science for Advanced Manufacturing
sources.evidence_excerpt: MDF described as greater than 100 manufacturing systems across powder bed, directed energy deposition, machining, polymer and convergent manufacturing, connected by a unified digital thread with multimodal data and digital twins.

sources.title: Quantum Optics and Bioimaging
sources.evidence_excerpt: Quantum-enhanced squeezed-light microscopy for label-free cells and tissues, crossing quantum sensing and biology.

sources.title: Microbial Synthetic Biologist
sources.evidence_excerpt: CRISPR/recombineering in non-model microbes, microbiome engineering, and organisms converting waste plastics/lignocellulosic biomass into fuels and chemicals.

sources.title: Quantum network protection with EPB
sources.evidence_excerpt: ORNL, EPB, and the University of Tennessee at Chattanooga demonstrated an entangled quantum signal over a commercial network with automatic polarization stabilization; the test ran for more than 30 hours without interruption.

sources.title: Quantum technologies on utility fiber
sources.evidence_excerpt: ORNL, LANL, EPB, and Qubitekk tested quantum key distribution systems with different hardware and software connected through substations.

sources.title: Nuclear Battery Initiative
sources.evidence_excerpt: ORNL describes long-duration nuclear batteries for remote environments and work on isotope selection, energy conversion, thermal management, advanced manufacturing, and aging.

sources.title: ORNL isotope capabilities
sources.evidence_excerpt: ORNL describes isotope research, production, and enrichment supporting medicine, national security, energy, industry, space, and science.

sources.title: Polymer-targeting enzymes
sources.evidence_excerpt: A team screened 95 enzymes for nylon 66 degradation, using AI and high-performance computing to narrow candidates and biology and chemistry to test them.

sources.title: AI-enhanced grid disturbance and wildfire detection
sources.evidence_excerpt: The platform classifies seven fault types, used more than 5,700 waveform signatures, increased signal strength from 6% to 72% in one test, and was being validated against five years of utility data.

sources.title: Center for Artificial Intelligence Security Research
sources.evidence_excerpt: CAISER evaluates AI risk across hardware, software, data supplies, cyber-physical interfaces, and human processes and describes Frontier-scale testing.

sources.title: AI-PhyX for electric-grid cybersecurity
sources.evidence_excerpt: AI-PhyX applies machine learning to vulnerability analysis, attack detection, threat mitigation, and recovery using a shared data pool.

sources.title: Situ and Heartbeat technology transfer
sources.evidence_excerpt: Situ analyzes streaming security data for suspicious behavior and Heartbeat analyzes hardware power measurements for malware signatures; both were licensed to U2opia.

sources.title: INTERSECT demonstration
sources.evidence_excerpt: A 2023 INTERSECT demonstration showed a sample-moving robot, a catalyst-development robot, and the AutoFlowS continuous-flow chemistry system; the initiative had been established in 2022.

sources.title: AutoFlowS project page
sources.evidence_excerpt: AutoFlowS is described as a continuous-flow chemistry system that can design and carry out a viable synthesis pathway, with applications in deuteration, site-specific functionalization, and sequence-controlled copolymerization.

sources.title: INTERSECT architecture specification
sources.evidence_excerpt: ORNL reported version 1.0 of an open INTERSECT architecture connecting instruments and robot-controlled laboratories with edge, cloud, and high-performance computing resources, using use-case patterns, system-of-systems design, and microservices.

sources.title: VENUS neutron imaging instrument
sources.evidence_excerpt: VENUS is a hyperspectral neutron imaging beamline at SNS for energy materials, additive manufacturing, geoscience, transportation, biology, forensics, and other applications; time-of-flight methods support energy-selective imaging.

sources.title: ORNL User Facilities access
sources.evidence_excerpt: ORNL lists HFIR, MDF, CNMS, OLCF, and SNS and describes proposal review, facility suitability, DOE objectives, and user agreements as access conditions.

sources.title: ORNL technical timeline
sources.evidence_excerpt: The public timeline connects early isotope and neutron work to computing, HFIR, OLCF, SNS, MDF, and Frontier.

sources.title: Ben Mintz staff profile
sources.evidence_excerpt: Ben Mintz is identified as Director of the INTERSECT Initiative and describes its goal as connecting HPC, edge computing, data analysis, and experimental instruments.

sources.title: Daniel Rosendo staff profile
sources.evidence_excerpt: Daniel Rosendo is identified in WES/NCCS and works on data science across the Instrument-to-Edge-to-HPC Continuum, cross-facility workflows, agentic AI, FAIR workflows, benchmarking, and provenance.

sources.title: Tyler Skluzacek staff profile
sources.evidence_excerpt: Tyler Skluzacek describes work on large-scale automated workflows and scientific data management, including secure programmatic access to OLCF computing and Globus Compute.

sources.title: Maxim Ziatdinov staff profile
sources.evidence_excerpt: Search discovery describes links between machine learning, instruments, HPC, streaming data, feedback, and autonomous microscopy; direct fetch remains pending.

sources.title: DataFed: Towards Reproducible Research via Federated Data Management
sources.publisher: DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information
sources.evidence_excerpt: DataFed is described as a lightweight distributed scientific data-management system spanning storage systems in a loosely coupled network of facilities, with metadata, provenance, interfaces, and reliable staging.

sources.title: ADIOS 2 publication record
sources.publisher: DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information
sources.evidence_excerpt: OSTI records ADIOS 2 as a 2020 SoftwareX article with DOI 10.1016/j.softx.2020.100561 and a multi-institution author list including ORNL researchers.

sources.title: Autonomous chemistry lab project
sources.evidence_excerpt: ORNL describes a fully automated chemistry lab using precise robotics, AI, chemical characterization, and electrochemical analysis for materials synthesis and discovery.

sources.title: ITAQPRO quantum edge node
sources.evidence_excerpt: ITAQPRO connects a quantum computer, simulator, or accelerator to INTERSECT edge nodes and HPC resources and uses AI/ML to optimize trapped-ion control.

sources.title: Automated microscopy and 4D STEM
sources.evidence_excerpt: The project links STEM instruments at CNMS to HPC through direct data transfer, structural reconstruction, and deep-kernel learning.

sources.title: AGILE grid laboratory
sources.evidence_excerpt: AGILE combines real-time grid simulation, laboratory digital twins, control nodes, and secure low-latency exchange at GRID-C.

sources.title: Open federated architecture project page
sources.evidence_excerpt: The project creates an INTERSECT open architecture specification with use-case patterns, system-of-systems design, and federated microservices.

sources.title: INTERSECT Integration Project
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Integration Project develops virtual infrastructure twins and testbeds using emulated beamline instruments, microscopes, and robots.

sources.title: Software Development Environment Project
sources.evidence_excerpt: ONE-SDE is described as a secure, reusable environment for interconnected science using loosely coupled services and reusable components.

sources.title: SMART Plant field systems
sources.evidence_excerpt: SMART Plant combines an all-terrain soil robot, aerial/ground/belowground sensors, real-time edge computing, and INTERSECT microservices in a field site with 200 poplar variants.

sources.title: Software deployment at facilities
sources.evidence_excerpt: The project addresses continuous integration, SDKs, Spack, containers, and build infrastructure for supported software stacks at DOE facilities.

sources.title: Autonomous additive manufacturing project page
sources.evidence_excerpt: The project connects robotics, in-process characterization, simulations, and applied mathematics across MDF, OLCF, and SNS.

sources.title: ORNL Software Catalog
sources.evidence_excerpt: The live catalog describes itself as ‘a hub for our open source projects’ and says the full catalog is updated regularly as repositories are added or modified.

sources.title: ORNL Software Catalog FAQ
sources.evidence_excerpt: The FAQ says content should be reviewed and released via SRS before placement in an ORNL GitHub.com repository; public GitHub-hosted repositories must exclude classified, export-controlled, OUO, HIPAA, PII, NDA/vendor-proprietary, UCI, and UCNI content.

sources.title: ORNL Software Licensing guidance
sources.evidence_excerpt: The licensing page says every ORNL software repository must have a root README.md containing an ORNL release number in the form ORNL-CODE-XXXXXX and recommends citation metadata.

sources.title: ORNL X post on hot-cell isotope production
sources.evidence_excerpt: ORNL describes a hot cell for safe handling and processing of radioactive materials supporting isotope production for deep-space systems and U.S. energy security; the image shows shielding, leaded windows, remote manipulators, and overhead equipment.

sources.title: ORNL ACORN research-activity-data project
sources.evidence_excerpt: ACORN says the project is the primary research object and links people, publications, organizations, funding, approvals, data, code, methods, and results; it validates portable research activity data and exports multiple formats.

sources.title: ORNL American Science Cloud project record
sources.evidence_excerpt: The project describes a federated infrastructure unifying data, AI models, HPC, science instruments, and DOE user facilities, with dataset discovery, intelligent agents, provenance, secure enclaves, and cross-site workflows.

sources.title: National MagLab PRISM scientific knowledge graph
sources.evidence_excerpt: PRISM is described as a pipeline generating a scientific knowledge graph containing instruments, datasets, researchers, and publications, with traceable links among files, datasets, researchers, and articles.

sources.title: OpenAIRE Graph
sources.evidence_excerpt: OpenAIRE describes a public graph linking research products, organizations, grants, communities, and persons through citations, funding, collaboration, and other relationships.

sources.title: NSF Open Knowledge Network
sources.evidence_excerpt: NSF describes a public infrastructure connecting 43 interconnected knowledge graphs and tens of billions of connected facts with attribution and governance.
